title: Compare scratch and library component directions
description: You fit library PCA and compare its first direction with the stored scratch result.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You fit SKPCA with two components on X2. The recording reports their explained variances.
You print the scratch direction from a column of comps2 and the library direction from a row of components_. Both recorded vectors are [0.45113454,0.89245595].

steps.question: What dot product results for the two recorded matching unit vectors?
steps.answer: The recording prints 1.0. Their unit directions align in this run.

steps.description: You see the matching directions beside the library variance ratios. The first recorded component accounts for most of the variance.
